maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Four distinct dark pixel clusters in the uppermost row, situated in a slightly ascending linear formation approximately 1.5 spot-diameters above the secondary dense row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The visible lateral and dorsal surfaces of the rhinarium exhibit approximately 95-98% melanin saturation, presenting as a uniform black pigmentation with minimal pale pixel intrusion at the ventral-most visible edge.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A continuous, shallowly concave contour edge connecting the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip, forming an approximately 145-degree angle relative to the horizontal plane of the maxilla.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single localized dark circular marking is visible on the nasal bridge, approximately equidistant between the medial canthus and the rhinarium.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast black pigmentation on the posterior surface of the pinna (ear back), creating a sharp boundary with the surrounding tawny fur.
